title: Measured masked witness recovery with additional fixed repairs
claims: MeasuredMaskedFill computes the indexed bit-mask reconstruction by a measured polynomial-time machine.
MaskedLogWitness checks P membership under the explicit polynomial clock and mask-coverage assumptions.
BoundedRepairPairVerifier checks polynomial-time decidability of a fixed repair schedule applied to a supplied candidate.
MaskedAndRepairedWitness composes both coverage methods under explicit hypotheses.

experiments.purpose: Bind the archived Lean modules and exact statements to the recorded local reference replay. The isolated experiment reports zero Lean invocations and can be complemented by replay with the pinned reference.
